blockers.message: Candidate, blocked and unassigned carrier rows are source-intake records, not approved historical PM99 identities.
Source gaps remain explicit and need evidence-backed editorial resolution before a strict package can write those fields.
Captured club squads are retained as evidence but have no fixed-carrier selection in this intake.
This intake has no player-slot bindings, managers, ratings, opening fixtures, kits, portraits, PM99 writes or runtime qualification.

scope_exclusions: No country, division, draw-pool, competition membership or foreign topology is inferred or written.
No captured player row is treated as a reconciled person, a PM99 player carrier or a roster-slot allocation.
No generated game tree, FDI, PKF or EXE is read or written by this source-only intake stage.
